subject: Critical-path MAP: tactical briefing & final confirmation for go-live week
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>, Samira Qureshi <samira@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Critical-path MAP: tactical briefing & final confirmation for go-live week

Hi Tom / Samira —

Quick tactical note ahead of our Friday checkpoint. Attached is version 3 of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v3.xlsx) and a living draft of the runbook (Runbook_draft.md). High level: we are tracking to the 2027-07-01 launch window, but we need final confirmation on these three critical items by end of day Thursday so we can lock the cutover roster.

Outstanding items (need owner + ETA):
- Final SSO cert thumbprint for test: (owner: Acme) — ETA?
- Data retention profile acceptance (30/90/365): (owner: Acme legal) — confirm
- Production cutover window: prefer 02:00-04:00 PDT (owner: Acme ops) — confirm

Internal ask: Ben / Karthik, please confirm rollback time estimate and clear fallback-tier if the KV cache warm-up fails. Laura — can you prepare the customer communications template (pre/post cutover)?

I've highlighted the critical-path rows in MAP_v3.xlsx (tab: "GoLive-Critical"). If Acme can confirm SSO + cutover window by Thu 23:59 PDT we will treat Friday as the final dry-run and lock the runbook.

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Runbook_draft.md (markdown), Cutover-checklist.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Marcus Lin

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Qureshi <samira@acmehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Critical-path MAP: tactical briefing & final confirmation for go-live week

Marcus —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. Quick clarifications from procurement/ops side:
1) SSO cert thumbprint: we have a cert rotation scheduled on 6/30. We can provide a test thumbprint by 6/28; production cert will be pushed during the cutover window (6/30–7/01).
2) Data retention: legal prefers 90 days by default with a 30-day option for specific cohorts — we are finalizing internal approval now; will update by Thu EOD.
3) Cutover window: Ops prefers 01:30–03:30 PDT to allow for east coast fallbacks. Can Redwood support that window?

Also, can you confirm who will own post-cutover application monitoring on Redwood's side for the first 48 hours?

Regards,
Tom
Director, Technical Operations
Acme Health
procurement@acmehealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-15T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Critical-path MAP: tactical briefing & final confirmation for go-live week

Tom —

01:30–03:30 PDT works from a capacity perspective; we will reserve dedicated capacity during that slot for the cutover and warm-up. On monitoring: Redwood will provide a 48-hour elevated watch — primary on-call will be me for customer-facing coordination, and Karthik will be primary infra/ops for model runtime issues.

Rollback plan (brief):
- If stateful KV warm-up fails >15 minutes into window: immediate rollback to canary model v0.9 in the Dedicated pool; expected rollback completion: 35–45 minutes.
- If SSO validation errors persist post cutover: roll network routes to pre-cutover gateway and open a hotfix branch for tokens; expected mitigation: 60–90 minutes.

Action items I own this week:
- Confirm dedicated capacity reservation & autoscale safety nets (ETA: 6/16 noon)
- Draft post-cutover monitoring runbook refined from Runbook_draft.md (ETA: 6/17 EOD)

I've attached the trimmed cutover checklist (Cutover-checklist.csv) with my annotations.

-Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

+1 510-555-0198

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Critical-path MAP: tactical briefing & final confirmation for go-live week

Folks —

Technical addendum to Ben's notes:
- Quantization/profile: for the launch we will serve model variant q4 with KV-cache pre-warm. If Acme expects high initial QPS (>=150 RPS) we should switch to q3 for the first 24 hours to avoid tail latency — recommend we keep q4 but have q3 as an immediate fallback.
- Cache warm-up: plan a 45-minute warm-up step inside the cutover window (first step). If warm-up metrics (95th pct latency) exceed threshold, trigger rollback.
- Database migrations: none planned for 7/1; any schema changes must be completed before 6/28.

I've uploaded a one-page runbook checklist into the shared runbook link and added a technical owner column in MAP_v3 (column: "TechOwner").

Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

--

From: Samira Qureshi <samira@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T16:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Critical-path MAP: tactical briefing & final confirmation for go-live week

Thanks all — confirming from Acme side: we accept the 01:30–03:30 PDT cutover window on 2027-07-01.

Decisions:
- SSO: Acme will provide the test thumbprint by 2027-06-28 and the production cert will be pushed during the 7/1 window.
- Data retention: legal confirmed 90-day default with 30-day cohort option; update reflected in MAP_v3.
- Monitoring: Acme requests Redwood to keep the elevated 48-hour watch and supply hourly status notes for the first 6 hours post cutover.

We have scheduled the final dry-run on 2027-06-25 at 09:00 PDT (calendar invite attached). Please ensure the runbook is updated with warm-up duration and rollback thresholds before then.

Samira Qureshi
Program Manager, Cloud Integrations
Acme Health
samira@acmehealth.com
